messages:
sara: FYI premerge SAST run flagged a cluster of auth checks in platform/api around the token exchange flow. Not huge stack traces but several similar callsites.
trent: Can you paste one of the findings? rule id / code snippet would help.
sara: Sure — from the SAST output: `S0101: missing auth check on /v1/session/refresh` — shows `if (user) return token` pattern. I'll paste the excerpt.
sara: ```js
// platform/api/session.js
async function refresh(req) {
  const user = await ctx.lookup(req.body.user_id)
  if (user) return createToken(user)
  // no explicit auth guard here
}
```
miguel: Hmm looks like an early-return that assumes caller validated user. Where is this invoked? could be internal-only but the router might expose it.
olivia: DAST also had a failing check on staging for /v1/session/refresh — a 302 redirect pattern that looked suspicious. I can repro with Burp quickly and share curl.
olivia: `curl -v -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/session/refresh -d '{"user_id": "123"}'` shows 302 -> /login in some cases.
trent: This smells like a role-based assumption lifted out. We need to confirm RBAC surface: which services call this endpoint and whether any public clients can reach it.
sara: Agreed. Suggested triage steps: 1) mark findings as P1 candidate, 2) run a quick grep for callers, 3) check routing ACLs in edge config, 4) check KMS/audit logs for recent calls.
miguel: I can grab edge ACLs and the ALB access logs. Also will query KMS audit for any API key usage around the last deploy window.
devsec-bot: Automated note: SAST run 1779504280 completed. 4 similar findings grouped. Link: https://ci.redwood/sast/job/1779504280
trent: Good. For the KMS question — do we have evidence of a service account using a key to mint tokens? if so that would show up in KMS audit with callerPrincipal.
miguel: Found two calls from service-account:token-mint@infra around 2026-03-19T15:02Z — they align with a canary release. Logging IDs: req-abc123, req-def456.
sara: Can someone check console -> audit-logs for those req IDs? we need to see user agent and source IP.
miguel: On it. Also checking who merged the PR that touched session.js last week.
olivia: I reproduced the DAST path: seems unauthenticated POST returns 302 when cookie absent, but 200 when cookie present. So not an outright bypass but inconsistent behavior that might lead to header-based auth confusion.
sara: That suggests a misconfigured middleware ordering — auth middleware may run after handler in some route variations.
trent: Action items: a) put premerge hold on the commit that introduced the change, b) assign an owner to fix ordering, c) add a test in the SDLC harness to run SAST + DAST pairing for session endpoints.
olivia: I'll open a ticket in GH with repro steps + burp request dump.
miguel: I'll attach ALB logs and KMS audit snippets to the ticket. Also recommend we rotate the ephemeral token used in the canary just in case — short TTL, but rotate anyway.
trent: For process: let's use the suppression/workflow policy — don't suppress these findings. treat as actionable until root cause found. If false positive, require code comment + reviewer signoff + evidence in the ticket.
sara: Also flagging for oncall security for visibility in case any customer traffic was impacted: @security-oncall please monitor.
devsec-bot: Incident workflow triggered: ticket #SEC-2026-213 created, priority P1 candidate. Please add remediation ETA.
trent: ETA for a patchable fix: 4 hours to revert the change or reorder middleware and add tests. I'll start a revert PR if owners are not available.
olivia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/platform/pull/4821 — includes failing test to prove regression.
miguel: KMS audit shows no anomalous key creation. Calls were from canary SA only. I'll put a short note in the ticket: no external key usage detected.
sara: Great. Final note for the playbook: update premerge CI to run a small DAST scenario for auth-sensitive routes and fail builds if mismatch between SAST and DAST behavior is detected.
trent: Agreed. I'll file a follow-up RFC to add DAST smoke tests to the premerge matrix and link the ticket. :thumbsup:
olivia: I'll add the reproducer and test vectors to the ticket before end of day.
sara: Thanks everyone — keep updates in SEC-2026-213 thread. Closing Slack thread.
